0022600221.text: The Grizzlies (7-3) host the Nuggets (5-4) in this regular season game, Memphis's 11th of the season. Memphis is 5-0 on the road but 2-3 at home, sits 3rd in the Southwest 1.5 games back and 7th in the West, and is on a W1 streak after going 7-3 over its last ten. Denver is on an L1 streak, sits 4th in the Northwest 2.5 games back and 10th in the West, and has gone 3-2 on the road and 2-2 at home. The 2026-27 season series has no games yet, while the Grizzlies lost the 2025-26 series 1-3, including a 136-119 regular season loss in Denver on April 8, 2026. Memphis is missing Richie Saunders (out, knee surgery) and Scotty Pippen Jr. (out, back soreness), with Isaiah Stewart (knee bruise) and Quinten Post (head) listed as day-to-day game-time decisions, and Denver is without Julian Strawther (out, knee sprain).
